info.title: API-DocTest-List Fitness Memberships Classes-v1-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Classes API provides users with access to a comprehensive list of fitness classes available under various membership plans. This functionality allows gym members and potential clients to explore different class options, schedules, and details directly through the application. Ideal for fitness enthusiasts and administrators alike, this API streamlines the class discovery process, enabling users to make informed decisions about their fitness journey. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance the user experience for fitness-related applications and platforms.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of classes available for memberships.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all classes associated with memberships. You can view the types of classes offered, their schedules, and other relevant details. Perfect for planning membership activities and maximizing benefits.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a list of classes available in the memberships section. Please ensure the request is properly formatted to receive the desired class data.
